chunks: From him, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: 'Why are you impatient for the advent of the Qaim? By Allah, his garment will be nothing but the coarse one, and his food nothing but barley with bran. And he is nothing but the sword, and death under the shade of the sword.'

key_terms.ظِلِّ ٱلسَّيۡفِ: Shade of the sword (under the sword's impact)

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of Imam Mahdi's (a.s.) attire, diet, and mode of rule according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) corrects the common misconception of a luxurious reign by emphasizing the Mahdi’s asceticism, noting his coarse clothing and simple diet of rough barley. This narration underscores the reality of the Ghaybah period as one of active military struggle, where the Imam’s primary instrument is the sword and his ultimate fate is martyrdom, reflecting the Shia tradition of the 'Sword of God' who conquers through both spiritual and physical jihad.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 473 - It is narrated from Mufaddal from Abdur Rahman bin Abi Hashim from Ali bin Abi Hamza from Abu Basir that

His Eminence, Abu Abdullah Sadiq (a.s) said: “Why are you impatient for the advent of Qaim (a.s)? By Allah, there will be no garments, except the coarse ones and no food, except barley with bran. His advent is not, except with the sword and death under the shade of the sword.”
